# costgraph_tenant (Data Source)

Read a tenant exposed by the configured API key. Returns the tenant name and organization ID. This lookup does not list or manage other tenants in the organization. An unavailable tenant returns an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tenant_id" {
  type = string
}

data "costgraph_tenant" "current" {
  id = var.tenant_id
}

output "tenant_name" {
  value = data.costgraph_tenant.current.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of a tenant accessible to the configured API key.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Tenant name shown in CostGraph.
- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization associated with the API key.
